entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: The ruthless naga khan of the Sultai, obsessed with revenge on the goblin who stole her crown and raising a great undead army.

entities.name: Jhinu
entities.description: A gaunt ape of a wealthy merchant family whom Sidisi keeps alive as a servant after he framed three goblins for the theft of her crown; he tries to assassinate her with a poisoned dagger.

entities.name: Mother Crocodile
entities.description: A huge crocodile in the pit at the center of Kheru Temple to which Sidisi feeds her enemies.

entities.name: Kheru Temple
entities.description: The Sultai seat of power with a throne room and crocodile pits.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: The clan of Tarkir ruled by khans who prove themselves through trickery and ruthlessness.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: A rival clan that Sidisi plans to destroy with her undead army.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: A clan from which Sidisi suspects the poisoned youth came.

entities.name: Rakshasa
entities.description: Sultai emissaries who wield magic and enforce Sidisi's army levy in noncompliant provinces.

entities.name: Sibsig
entities.description: The undead beings of the Sultai, used as servants and soldiers.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: The orc khan of the Mardu whom Sidisi plans to turn into a trophy.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: A figure from Sultai history whose army Sidisi aims to surpass.

entities.name: Niraj River
entities.description: A river whose tax collection Jhinu sought to monopolize; his home province.

entities.name: Objung Swamps
entities.description: The swamps where orchids used for Silumgar's Breath poison bloom.

entities.name: Silumgar's Breath
entities.description: A rare, expensive, incurable poison distilled from orchid stems.

events.summary: Sidisi sits crownless, obsessed with revenge on a goblin who took her crown, having fed her warning advisors to the Mother Crocodile.
events.quote: One by one, her most trusted advisors had warned her against the course of blind revenge

events.summary: In a flashback, Sidisi took the crown from the severed head of the previous khan and purged her rivals.
events.quote: The crown had once been taken by Sidisi herself, off of the freshly severed head of the previous khan.

events.summary: Jhinu is revealed to have framed three dead goblins for stealing her crown to win tax duties, and Sidisi has kept him alive as a living reminder of fates worse than death.
events.quote: She kept him alive as a reminder to all that there were fates worse than death.

events.summary: Sidisi mocks Jhinu that no relative is left to barter for his life and threatens to give him to the pits.
events.quote: If nobody is left who would barter for your life, maybe you are worthless.

events.summary: Sidisi explains she has raised an army by levying five percent of each province, then demanding the eldest born, with Rakshasa enforcing compliance.
events.quote: she had requested that all of the Sultai provinces provide five percent of their population to be enlisted into Sidisi's army.

events.summary: Jhinu presents recruits from the Niraj province, and Sidisi spots a thirteen-year-old youth among them.
events.quote: In the back was a youth, no more than thirteen years old.

events.summary: The youth attacks Sidisi with a poisoned dagger, but she hurls Jhinu into him and breaks the youth's neck.
events.quote: The youth attempted to regain his footing, but found the queen's tail around his neck.

events.summary: Sidisi identifies the poison on Jhinu as Silumgar's Breath, realizing the attack was a personal attempt on her life.
events.quote: It was known as Silumgar's Breath

events.summary: Sidisi kills Jhinu by thrusting the dagger into his chest rather than letting him suffer.
events.quote: Sidisi picked up the dagger and thrust it squarely into Jhinu's chest.

events.summary: Sidisi resolves never again to show mercy and plans to raise a vast army to destroy the Mardu and humiliate Zurgo.
events.quote: Soon, the great orc Zurgo himself would adorn her palace as her greatest prize.

relations.note: She is khan and queen of the Sultai.
relations.quote: to the Queen of the Sultai, the dead's lips are as easily moved as those of the living.

relations.note: She stabs him with the poisoned dagger.
relations.quote: Sidisi picked up the dagger and thrust it squarely into Jhinu's chest.

relations.note: He serves her as a servant kept alive in disgrace.
relations.quote: Jhinu," Sidisi hissed. "I am hungry. Bring me my food.

relations.note: She plans to defeat the Mardu and make Zurgo a trophy.
relations.quote: Soon, the great orc Zurgo himself would adorn her palace as her greatest prize.

relations.note: She plans to march on the Mardu with an undead army.
relations.quote: An army of Sibsig that would cover the entire steppe and march tirelessly on the Mardu until their horses died of exhaustion.

relations.note: Rakshasa emissaries enforce her army levy.
relations.quote: Rakshasa emissaries sent to the provinces who were not compliant quickly quelled any risk of an uprising.
